title: Manifest declares every capability class the artifact uses (declared strictly larger than used)
mechanism: used_capabilities = {filesystem} is a strict subset of declared_capabilities = {filesystem, network, credentials}. Over-declaration is not a violation; only under-declaration is.
rationale: Negative control for I-17. It guards two distinct false positives: (a) a gate that demanded set equality rather than the subset relation the predicate actually states, and (b) a gate that mishandled the empty/unused network and credentials classes. Both would be red here while the shipped predicate is green.
